name: Kiddie Matinee
description: It's Howdy Doody time! Afternoon TV for kids from the 1940s to the early 60s: Howdy Doody, Kukla, Fran and Ollie, Ding Dong School, Rootie Kazootie, Winky Dink, Pinky Lee, Super Circus, Watch Mr. Wizard, Captain Video, Space Patrol, Tom Corbett, Flash Gordon, Supercar. Rocky Jones, Space Ranger blasts off weekdays at 5:00 pm, and Fireball XL5 flies Saturday mornings at 9:00, both in episode order.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 85 hours of 1948-62 children's TV episodes from the Classic TV collection and whole-series items; Rocky Jones and Fireball XL5 slots from complete-series items. Excluded westerns already on Saddle Up, the 1987 Howdy Doody anniversary special, colorized Commando Cody and Fireball XL5 uploads, a three-hour Rootie Tootie party broadcast, Diver Dan (seven-minute fragments), commercials and older duplicate uploads of the same Howdy Doody, Super Circus, Pinky Lee, Mr. Wizard, Winky Dink and Captain Video episodes.
